lead.headline: OKX hits $25B valuation as Coinbase rebuilds institutional stack, while Abstract's collapse marks L2 reckoning
lead.tldr: Exchange infrastructure is repricing upward on institutional traction, but the layer-2 land grab is showing casualties as capital concentrates in proven tokenization and regulated on-ramps.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today's brief tracks capital flowing toward regulated exchange infrastructure and tokenized real-world assets while the L2 experiment loses another well-funded contender.

top_signals.title: OKX exchange raises fresh capital at $25B valuation
top_signals.summary: OKX has successfully raised new capital from a group of strategic investors and partners. The funding round establishes a valuation of $25 billion for the exchange.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A $25 billion valuation for OKX in this funding environment signals that strategic investors are underwriting exchange equity on institutional penetration metrics rather than retail volume alone, which reprices the entire CEX competitive set.

top_signals.title: Spiko raises $90 million to expand tokenized cash funds across markets
top_signals.summary: Spiko has raised $90 million in its latest funding round to expand its tokenized cash fund offerings across various markets. This brings the company's total capital raised to $120 million with assets under management now reaching $2.7 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Spiko's $90 million raise to push tokenized cash funds past $2.7 billion AUM demonstrates that the RWA thesis has moved from proof-of-concept to scale-out financing, with traditional fund structures now being unbundled onto permissioned chains.

top_signals.title: Coinbase Pro to return; Deribit integration creates Coinbase Global Exchange
top_signals.summary: Coinbase is set to relaunch Coinbase Pro by the end of the year. Additionally, the company has integrated with Deribit to establish the Coinbase Global Exchange.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Coinbase's dual move—resurrecting Pro and integrating Deribit into a Global Exchange—reveals a strategy to own the full institutional workflow from spot through derivatives, effectively building a vertically integrated prime brokerage that competitors will have to match or exit.

top_signals.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
top_signals.summary: Ethereum layer-2 project Abstract is shutting down on December 15 following significant financial losses. CEO Luca Netz cited a failure to achieve product-market fit as the primary reason for the closure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Abstract's shutdown after tens of millions in losses, despite Pudgy Penguins' brand and Luca Netz's track record, is the clearest admission yet that L2 deployment without sustained transaction demand is just a burn rate in search of a business model.

top_signals.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing19m
top_signals.summary: A Winklevoss-backed entity has officially filed with the SEC for the listing of a Zcash ETF on the Nasdaq. This move represents a push to bring privacy-focused digital assets into regulated investment vehicles.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Zcash ETF filing tests whether privacy-preserving assets can clear the SEC's surveillance-sharing bar, and if approved, it would force a repricing of the entire privacy token category by creating a regulated bid that currently does not exist.

Spiko has raised $90 million in its latest funding round to expand its tokenized cash fund offerings across various markets. This brings the company's total capital raised to $120 million with assets under management now reaching $2.7 billion.

Amsterdam-based cybersecurity startup Hadrian has raised $40 million in a funding round led by Forgepoint and SmartFin. The investment comes as the company seeks to combat the acceleration of AI-driven cyberattacks.

on_the_radar.title: UK names 6 banks to lead first digitally native government bond
on_the_radar.summary: The UK government has selected six major financial institutions to lead the issuance of its first digitally native government bond. This move signals a significant step toward the tokenization of sovereign debt and the modernization of government financial infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: Fortitude expands Zcash mining push with up to $100 million equipment commitment
on_the_radar.summary: Fortitude is expanding its commitment to Zcash mining with a planned investment of up to $100 million in hardware equipment. This move aims to bolster the security and decentralization of the Zcash network through increased hashing power.

on_the_radar.title: Q3 Crypto Market Review, Bitget/Near Exploits, and Privacy's Next Era
on_the_radar.summary: A comprehensive Q3 review highlighting Bitcoin's rise above $80K and strong Ethereum performance driven by ETF inflows and DEX volumes. The report also addresses the $387 million Bitget exploit and the Ethereum Foundation's new ZK API initiative for privacy and AI.

on_the_radar.title: Hong Kong officials double down on end-2026 deadline for crypto licensing bill
on_the_radar.summary: The Hong Kong government has reaffirmed its commitment to implementing a comprehensive crypto licensing regime by the end of 2026. The proposed framework will cover four distinct categories of digital assets to provide regulatory clarity.

on_the_radar.title: Ondo launches onchain private-company exposure, starting with AI
on_the_radar.summary: Ondo has launched tokenized private-company notes, beginning with exposure to a pre-IPO AI firm. These assets will track per-share value and allow for 24/7 trading on secondary markets.

on_the_radar.title: Solana Foundation targets settlement in seconds with DvP launch9m
on_the_radar.summary: The Solana Foundation is launching a Delivery versus Payment (DvP) framework to enable near-instant settlement of assets. This initiative aims to reduce counterparty risk and increase efficiency in the exchange of digital assets.

on_the_radar.title: Bitcoin.de trading remains halted as German regulator rejects MiCA application
on_the_radar.summary: German exchange Bitcoin.de continues to face trading halts after the regulator BaFin rejected its application for MiCA authorization. The company is now searching for regulated partners to resume its operations.

on_the_radar.title: ‘Most dangerous product in crypto’ vexes Singapore
on_the_radar.summary: Singaporean regulators are expressing concern over Hyperliquid Labs and its perpetual futures trading products, which are viewed as high-risk. The city-state is attempting to distance itself from the platform to avoid potential scandal and financial instability.

linkedin_post:
Coinbase is building what looks like a prime brokerage. OKX just got priced at $25 billion. These are not the same business, but they rhyme on one thing: the money is in owning the institutional on-ramp, not in launching another chain.

We have watched the L2 thesis get tested hard. Abstract had capital, a known founder, and Pudgy Penguins' distribution. It is shutting in December. Luca Netz called it product-market fit failure. That is honest. It is also expensive. The tens of millions lost there did not disappear; they were transferred to infrastructure providers, to payroll, to Ethereum mainnet fees. This is how the sector cleanses.

What gets repriced now is not just Abstract's equity. It is the assumption that any execution environment can capture value if the application layer is thin. Our portfolio company Spiko is running the opposite playbook—$2.7 billion in AUM, $90 million fresh in, building on top of existing rails rather than minting new ones. Tokenized cash funds do not need a new chain. They need compliance, liquidity, and a yield spread.

The Zcash ETF filing is a separate bet. Privacy assets in a regulated wrapper is a hard problem the SEC has not yet said yes to. If it clears, the category re-rates overnight. If not, the filing still tells us where sophisticated allocators are looking for edge.

We underwrite infrastructure on customer concentration and retention. The exchanges are winning both. The L2s are not.
